questions.question: When is World Thyroid Day celebrated every year?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**25 May**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World Thyroid Day: 25 May.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**World Thyroid Day** is celebrated every year on **25th May**.

 
 
• 
 
It was decided during the **Thyroid Federation International** meeting in **September 2007**.

 
 
• 
 
The first World Thyroid Day was celebrated in **2008**.

 
 
• 
 
The **theme** for this year is **“Thyroid Disease and Artificial Intelligence”**.

 
 
• 
 
The **European Thyroid Association** also started **European Thyroid Day** on **25th May 2008**.

questions.question: When is World Meteorological Day officially observed each year?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**23 March**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World Meteorological Day is observed every year on 23 March.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**World Meteorological Day** is observed every year on **23 March**.

 
 
• 
 
In **2024**, the **World Meteorological Organization (WMO)** confirmed that it was the **hottest year on record**.

 
 
• 
 
World Meteorological Day commemorates the coming into force of the **Convention** establishing the **WMO** on **23 March 1950**.

 
 
• 
 
The theme for **World Meteorological Day 2025** is **"Closing the early warning gap together"**.

 
 
• 
 
The headquarters of the **World Meteorological Organization (WMO)** are located in **Geneva, Switzerland**.

questions.question: What is the theme for Earth Day 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Our Power, Our Planet**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Earth Day: 22nd April.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**First Earth Day:** Celebrated in **1970**.

 
 
• 
 
**Founder:** Senator **Gaylord Nelson** of the USA.

 
 
• 
 
**Celebration Year:** In **2025**, Earth Day will be celebrated for its **55th year**.

 
 
• 
 
**2025 Theme:** **"Our Power, Our Planet"**.

 
 
• 
 
**Main Goal for 2025:** Achieve the **"triple clean electricity" target by 2030** through the use of **renewable energy**

questions.question: What is the theme of World Oceans Day 2025?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World Oceans Day: 8 June.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

•

questions.question: When was Project Tiger launched by the Government of India?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**1973**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India celebrates 52 years of Project Tiger: A global conservation success story.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Project Tiger's 52-Year Legacy**: India celebrates 52 years of Project Tiger, launched in 1973 to protect the country’s tiger population.

 
 
• 
 
**Tiger Population Growth**: India’s tiger population surged from 1,411 in 2006 to 3,682 in 2022, now hosting 75% of the world’s wild tigers.

 
 
• 
 
**Tiger Reserves**: India now has 57 tiger reserves, covering 83,000 sq km of forest land. Tamil Nadu alone houses five reserves across 6,200 sq km.

 
 
• 
 
**Doubling Tiger Numbers**: India achieved the goal of doubling tiger numbers ahead of schedule, as per the ‘St. Petersburg Declaration on Tiger Conservation.’

 
 
• 
 
**International Big Cats Alliance**: Launched in 2023, India also took leadership in global big cat conservation with this initiative.

 
 
• 
 
**NTCA**: The National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) plays a critical role in the implementation of Project Tiger.

questions.question: What is the theme for World Mental Health Day this year?(2024)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mental Health at Work.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **World Mental Health Day is being observed across the globe today, aiming to raise awareness about mental health issues.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **This year’s theme is "Mental Health at Work," emphasizing the importance of fostering mental health in workplaces.**
 
• The theme encourages collective action to protect against harm and support those in need of help.
 
• According to the National Mental Health Survey conducted in 2015-16, nearly 10.6% of adults in India suffered from mental health disorders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• World Mental Health Day__

 __
 
• Observed on October 10 every year to raise awareness of mental health issues and mobilize efforts for mental health care.
 
• It is an opportunity for all stakeholders to talk about mental health and its impact on individuals and communities.
 
 
 
• Mental Health in the Workplace__
 
 
• Creating a supportive work environment is essential for employee well-being and productivity.
 
• Employers are encouraged to implement policies and practices that promote mental health at work.

questions.question: What is the 2025 theme for World Population Day?

options.text: Population Control for a Sustainable Earth
Empowering young people to create the families they want in a fair and hopeful world

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Empowering young people to create the families they want in a fair and hopeful world**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World Population Day: 11 July.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**World Population Day** is observed **annually on July 11**.

 
 
• 
 
In **2025**, the **global population crosses 8.1 billion**, and **India becomes the most populous country**.

 
 
• 
 
The day was established in **1989** by the **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)**.

 
 
• 
 
It was inspired by **Five Billion Day** (**July 11, 1987**) — when the **world population reached 5 billion**.

 
 
• 
 
**Theme for 2025**:
 **“Empowering young people to create the families they want in a fair and hopeful world.”**

questions.question: What is the theme of World Environment Day 2025?

options.text: Putting an End to Plastic Pollution

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Putting an End to Plastic Pollution**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World Environment Day: 5 June.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**World Environment Day** is celebrated every year on **5 June**.

 
 
• 
 
The **2025 theme** is **"Putting an End to Plastic Pollution"**.

 
 
• 
 
It supports the **UNEP-led #BeatPlasticPollution campaign**.

 
 
• 
 
**Established in 1972** during the **UN Conference on the Human Environment** in **Stockholm**.

 
 
• 
 
Officially **designated by the UN General Assembly** in 1972.

 
 
• 
 
The **first celebration** was held in **1973** with the theme **"Only One Earth"**.

 
 
• 
 
**South Korea** is the **official host** of **World Environment Day 2025**.

questions.question: What is the theme of World Water Day 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Glacier Preservation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World Water Day, celebrated on 22 March every year since 1993, focuses on the importance of freshwater.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**World Water Day** is celebrated on **22 March** every year, focusing on the **importance of freshwater**.

 
 
• 
 
The core focus is to support the achievement of **Sustainable Development Goal 6**: **water and sanitation for all** by **2030**.

 
 
• 
 
The theme for **World Water Day 2025** is **‘Glacier Preservation’**.

 
 
• 
 
The **UN-Water’s flagship World Water Development Report 2025** is titled **‘Water Towers: Mountains and glaciers’**.

 
 
• 
 
**World Water Day** was established in **1992** by the **United Nations** during the **Conference on Environment and Development** in **Rio de Janeiro, Brazil**.

 
 
• 
 
The first observance of World Water Day took place on **22 March 1993**.

questions.question: When is National Panchayati Raj Day celebrated?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**April 24**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• National Panchayati Raj Day 2025: 24 April.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
Celebrated **every year on April 24**.

 
 
• 
 
Marks the implementation of the **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992** (enforced in 1993).

 
 
• 
 
**Strengthens grassroots democracy** and empowers rural communities.

 
 
• 
 
**Three-tier structure**:

 
 
• 
 
**Village Panchayat** (headed by a Sarpanch)

 
 
• 
 
**Panchayat Samiti** (covers 20–60 villages, headed by a Pradhan)

 
 
• 
 
**Zilla Parishad** (district level)

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Gram Sabha** includes all adult members of a village; oversees the Village Panchayat.

 
 
• 
 
**50% reservation** in Panchayat seats for women, SCs, and STs.

 
 
• 
 
Not implemented in **Nagaland, Mizoram, Meghalaya, Delhi.**

 
 
• 
 
The first National Panchayati Raj Day, also called Panchayati Raj Diwas, was celebrated in 2010. It was officially declared by the then Prime Minister Manmohan Singh.

 
 
• 
 
The Ministry of Panchayati Raj was created in 2004 which handles all matters related to Panchayati Raj and is led by a cabinet minister.

 
 
• 
 
Some tribal and special areas also do not have Panchayati Raj. These include hilly areas of Manipur, Darjeeling in West Bengal, and some scheduled regions.
